questions.question: In digital CMOS circuit design, what is the primary operational advantage of a complementary CMOS transmission gate (TG) compared to a single NMOS pass-transistor switch?
options: It transmits both strong logic '1' (full VDD) and strong logic '0' (ground) levels without suffering a threshold voltage drop.
It eliminates all static leakage current during the off state by automatically applying reverse body biasing to the substrate.
It operates using only a single uncomplemented control signal, eliminating the need for an inverted gate control line.
It presents substantially lower total input gate capacitance than an isolated NMOS transistor of equivalent drive strength.
It provides active voltage amplification to restore degraded signal edges without downstream inverter stages.

questions.question: In deep-submicron IC layout and physical design, what is the 'antenna effect' (plasma-induced damage), and how is it primarily mitigated during routing?
options: High-frequency electromagnetic emissions from clock nets that induce crosstalk; mitigated by placing grounded shield wires parallel to sensitive signals.

Accumulation of electrostatic charge on long interconnects during plasma etching that can rupture thin gate oxides; mitigated by inserting reverse-biased diodes or routing jumpers to higher metal layers.
Parasitic package inductance causing ground bounce during simultaneous switching; mitigated by placing distributed on-chip decoupling capacitors near power pads.
Capacitive substrate injection from fast-switching digital I/O buffers into analog blocks; mitigated by surrounding sensitive cells with guard rings.
Electromigration voids formed near via interfaces due to directional electron flow; mitigated by widening lower-level metal tracks and adding redundant vias.

questions.question: In digital IC Design for Testability (DFT), what is the primary operational role of a Multiple-Input Signature Register (MISR) within a Logic Built-In Self-Test (LBIST) architecture?
options: Generating pseudo-random test pattern vectors using linear feedback polynomials to stimulate the circuit under test.
Converting parallel scan chain inputs into high-speed serialized data streams for external ATE (Automated Test Equipment) capture.
Compressing the multi-cycle output response sequences from the circuit under test into a compact digital signature for pass/fail comparison.
Tracking instantaneous dynamic supply voltage drops across the core during structural at-speed transition delay testing.
Synchronizing asynchronous test clock domains between the internal test controller and external JTAG boundary-scan chains.

questions.question: In modern high-performance processor microarchitectures, what is the primary operational mechanism of store-to-load forwarding (store forwarding)?
options: Coalescing multiple consecutive write instructions to the same cache line in the write buffer before issuing a single burst transaction to main memory.
Routing arithmetic computation results directly from an execution unit back to pipeline reservation stations to eliminate register file read stalls.
Speculatively prefetching data lines from the L2 cache directly into the L1 data cache ahead of confirmed load instruction addresses.
Allowing a load instruction to read its operand directly from an older, pending store entry in the store queue when their target addresses match, without waiting for the store to commit to cache.
Demoting modified data lines from L1 directly into an uncore victim buffer to free cache ways for incoming instruction streams.

questions.question: In multi-core Network-on-Chip (NoC) interconnects utilizing wormhole routing, how do Virtual Channels (VCs) fundamentally prevent network deadlocks?
options: By discarding blocked flits at intermediate routers and relying on end-to-end transport layer retransmissions upon a packet timeout.
By dynamically modulating the operating voltage and frequency of congested physical links to drain buffer queues faster.
By forcing all packets onto a single physical bus where arbitration strictly follows a non-blocking round-robin schedule.
By dynamically converting packet flits into parallel circuits through centralized crossbar reservation matrices.
By decoupling buffer resource allocation from physical link allocation, allowing non-blocked packets to logically bypass packets waiting on full downstream buffers.
